visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An anthropomorphic dog featuring a black-and-white face is styled with a long, wavy brown wig and wears a dark, patterned floral dress. The character sits stoically behind a cluttered wooden desk filled with stacks of parchment and small wooden boxes. Several small, green, translucent ghost-like entities with large, toothy grins float and swirl through a thick, hazy mist that fills the room, creating a surreal and eerie environment. (2) As the small green spirits drift closer, the dog-character becomes agitated, tracking their erratic movements with wide, focused eyes. It repeatedly opens its mouth wide and snaps its jaws shut with visible effort, attempting to bite the ghosts out of the misty air. The background remains a soft-focus, greyish indoor environment with subtle lighting that emphasizes the glowing neon green of the ghosts against the muted tones of the character's clothing. (3) The character suddenly brandishes a black mesh fly swatter, swinging it vigorously through the air to strike the floating green creatures. Each swing is accompanied by a change in the character's posture, shifting from a seated position to an active, defensive stance as it bats at the entities. The thick mist continues to swirl around the desk as the ghosts are knocked aside or fly away from the forceful movements.

This is layered over a continuous, high-tempo electronic background track featuring a steady, synthesized percussive beat and repeating melodic stabs. The buzzing sound continues to fluctuate in volume and pitch, simulating the movement of multiple small entities. These sounds are synchronized with the visual swinging motion and stand out prominently against the ongoing BGM loop. The audio intensity remains high throughout, maintaining a frenetic energy without any moments of silence.
